items.prompt: Prove cut exchange and terminal cases.
items.modelAnswer: The current-component cut respects the chosen forest. The accepted edge is lightest across that cut. Add it to an MST containing the forest; remove another crossing edge on the cycle that is at least as costly and not already chosen. This preserves some MST containing all choices. Skip self-links and same-component edges. Fewer than n-1 selected after all edges means disconnected; use a wide exact total.
